# Bounded source readings for the channel laboratory

This additive reading layer describes what selected retained documents say and how their conditions differ. It does not authenticate claimed entities, measure supernatural effects, validate financial or clinical guidance, or score predictions against outcomes. Computational coverage of the full frame and substantive source reading are different operations.

The current source-read release contains **12 purposive cases**, with **10,006 unique inspected words in 22 of 493 canonical source units** (0.709% of the 1,411,446-word frame). It covers 9 of 26 publisher contexts. Five complete retained bodies were read: four short official Bashar excerpt texts and the Michael publisher message. The other inspections are bounded passages. Reading a short highlight completely does not mean reading its complete paid session.

**Additional editions:** three Parakeet Council editions contributed 2,124 separately inspected words. Their character offsets, bodies and provenance are explicitly noncanonical. They are excluded from the primary case supports and primary reading-word total. No audio was listened to in this pass; neither old nor new recognition is treated as ground truth.

## Selection before new rankings

[selection-plan.json](selection-plan.json) was frozen at 18:31:46 UTC on 8 November 2026, before this role inspected any new channel-lab similarity or topic results. Selection used prior accepted qualitative findings, source-title inventory, repeated printed names across distinct mediums, differing conditions, and a documentary refusal/correction control. It was not random, registered externally, or selected to estimate topic prevalence. All twelve candidates received dispositions; none was silently replaced with a more favorable embedding neighbor.

One frozen Passion Principle selector refers to an excluded duplicate publication, Vimeo 204086275. Its complete normalized text is identical to the selected Vimeo 204072408 edition (body SHA begins `7d65f3fd1bd49d72`); the explicit body-alias join contributes one canonical observation. A prior skeptical-window field named `text_sha256` was found to bind a JSON artifact, not the normalized body. The generator verifies the correct canonical body hash and the unchanged exact passage. Both distinctions were caught before release and the earlier inspection records are preserved privately.

Literal keyword retrieval was used only to locate the previously selected first-distortion/refusal and intensity/correction examples within Ra sessions 68 and 77. All returned complete exchanges actually inspected remain in coverage, including nearby passages not used as decisive case evidence. Keywords locate text; they do not decide its meaning or truth. Other selected passages came from fixed prior windows, accepted card supports or complete short source bodies.

## Findings with counter-readings

The cases illustrate concrete distinctions:

- The Passion Principle highlight includes skills, preparation, collaborators and persistence. Reducing it to an instruction to follow excitement omits much of the retained sequence. Ra 10.14 foregrounds contemplative recognition instead. The difference is local emphasis, not a universal contrast between active and passive traditions.
- The fear excerpt uses belief and frequency language; the Ra desire passage includes acceptance and free-will qualifications. Desire, fear and empathy are not interchangeable constructs, and scientific-sounding language does not supply an operational test.
- Ra 36.4–36.6 changes reference frame when discussing a higher self and time. A broad similarity to the Bashar single-moment account does not establish one formal model or a contradiction.
- Council is not a stable shared identifier. Daniel's narrator proposes a different council; Tracy explicitly discusses flexible naming and fluid membership. The Pamela interview includes multiple claimed speakers and a change of context.
- The two Mother Mary messages concern different trust referents. A practical tension requires extending metaphysical trust to a draining interpersonal relationship. That extension is not an explicit source contradiction.
- The Mary Magdalene texts use grace-initiation and shadow-integration frames. Their common acceptance vocabulary does not make their procedures identical.
- Optional invocation can coexist with a rejection of necessary hierarchy. Removing optionality would change the comparison.
- A contact-titled official highlight mainly discusses lessons and free choice in its retained text; a skeptical commentary window recounts a performance and a joke. Neither title nor topic mention licenses an endorsement or speaker-attribution inference.
- Ra 68.9 refuses an individualized answer, 68.10 answers a generic reformulation, and 77.15 corrects its questioner. A question's premise is not automatically part of its answer.

| Case ID | Focus | Scoped relation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `practice-action` | Contemplation, skill and action | different focus |
| `fear-desire` | Acceptance of desire and belief-based fear | different focus |
| `time-reference` | Future-relative higher self and a single-moment account | unresolved |
| `council-definition` | A proposed council is not every council | unresolved |
| `council-timing` | Conditional language is not a calibrated probability | unresolved |
| `mary-support` | Two Mother Mary labels, two trust referents | conditional tension |
| `magdalene-change` | Grace and shadow are different practice frames | different focus |
| `mediation-optional` | Optional invocation and direct access | compatible |
| `michael-awareness` | Attention during change and contemplative recognition | shared proposition |
| `reception-genre` | A topic mention can be commentary rather than endorsement | different focus |
| `preparedness` | Skills, collaborators and community | shared proposition |
| `answer-limits` | A refusal, a reframed question and a correction | different focus |

The set contains five differences of focus, three unresolved comparisons, two narrow shared propositions, one compatibility and one conditional tension. No explicit contradiction was established in these twelve selected cases. That zero is not a corpus contradiction rate, a reliability statistic or a claim that other passages agree. Sources recur across cases, so the comparisons are dependent.

## Evidence and public schema

`readings.json` contains `source_bindings`, `coverage`, `channel_notes`, `cases`, `candidate_dispositions`, `additional_edition_readings`, `additional_evidence` and limitations. Each case separates an analyst comparison question, actor/proposition statements, conditions, temporal scope, genre, relation, counter-reading and evidence. `qualitative_theme_keys` are analyst navigation labels, separate from numerical topic IDs or cluster assignments.

Each evidence record binds canonical source ID, selected and inspected edition IDs, body SHA-256, end-exclusive NFKC-normalized character endpoints, span SHA-256 and word count. Printed Ra question IDs and existing knowledge-bank question IDs remain distinct. Existing question links can open the earlier knowledge dashboard using `?q=question_id`; an old card is not rebound to new Parakeet wording. Source URLs and recognized segment times aid inspection but are not acoustic-accuracy or diarization certificates.

Full bodies, exact quoted evidence and local artifact paths remain private. Public cases use short paraphrases with qualifications. The private evidence artifact permits an independent reviewer to reconstruct every hash, offset, union-of-interval word total and alias join. The public allowlist contains only `readings.json`; documentation is published from repository source files.

## Research framing and novelty limits

The contribution is an inspectable integration of a retained-source inventory, source-aware numerical views, bounded readings and edition comparisons. It is not a novel embedding algorithm, a first-ever study of channeling, a validated contradiction detector or new evidence for attributed beings. A literature search limited to these methods cannot establish priority over all related work.

The existing [14-source literature register](../knowledge-bank/literature-register.json) and [two report additions](../knowledge-bank/report/additional-references.json) are reused with their actual access depths. De Marneffe, Rafferty and Manning's contradiction work motivates explicit scope and referent checks; Datasheets and PROV-O motivate documentary provenance; Sentence-BERT/MMTEB contextualize task-specific representation evaluation. GraphRAG/HippoRAG/RAPTOR motivate separate future retrieval experiments, not claims that the present graph authenticates shared entities. Ethayarajh's contextual-geometry abstract is background, not validation of every local token cluster. Google's Sleep framework updates model weights; this case bank does not reproduce that training method.

A falsifiable next descriptive check, proposed before seeing the new rankings, compares the same-name Mary/Magdalene cross-medium pairs against different-name within-medium pairs under matched representation and length settings. Reversal would expose fragility; stable ordering could still reflect source style, genre or curation. Pair counts must not be treated as independent observations. Human annotation reliability, listening-verified ASR, event-outcome evaluation and matched source sampling remain future work.

## Reproduction

```sh
python research/channel-lab/build_readings.py \
  --frame ACCEPTED_PRIVATE_FRAME_JSON \
  --inspection PRIVATE_INSPECTION_JSON \
  --cases research/channel-lab/cases-spec.json \
  --selection research/channel-lab/selection-plan.json \
  --output FRESH_PRIVATE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY
```

The builder rejects changed bodies, invalid spans, ambiguous alias joins, inheritance of a card onto a changed edition, missing candidate dispositions and private paths in public output. It computes reading coverage from merged intervals within each edition and emits an exact byte/hash `output-manifest.json` allowlist. Passing integrity checks establishes what was read and published, not that an interpretation or source claim is true. Actual panel milestones and corrections are recorded in [PANEL.md](PANEL.md).

## Executed validation

Independent provenance checks covered all 52 inspected spans (46 canonical and six alternative), all 12 complete printed Ra question/response joins, the three alternative-edition/audio bindings and the merged reading totals. A separate model-agent semantic re-reading covered 16 decisive spans / 2,512 words in the Mary, Magdalene, time-reference and refusal/correction cases; no substantive paraphrase correction was requested. This does not certify all 493 sources or human annotation reliability. The final metadata rebind is recorded in the private `review/readings02-independent.json` receipt.

Three integration controls passed: overlapping support ranges count once, changed editions reject inherited support, and undisposed frozen candidates prevent publication. The accepted public `readings.json` SHA-256 is `46a25899c74d7af30b118fa6a9e7280a70443d650db72ce09305b7ba7a599b2b`, bound to frame 02 SHA-256 `0d69378f9e9a2280e7ed05981b647fbfe280016380b3072b2b3a320961ae2c8c`. Full quoted evidence is excluded from the public allowlist.
